recent.text: #Broncos’ salary cap update
recent.author: Troy Renck
recent.quoted_text: #Broncos created some cap space yesterday by converting the remaining $5.5 million of Talanoa Hufanga’s 2026 salary, as @JFowlerESPN noted. Creates a shade more than $3.9 million in room for this year. Denver took on $1.84 million in trading for Daiyan Henley.

recent.text: This creates some wiggle room for the Broncos in the second half of the season after they added about $1.8 million in salary with the Daiyan Henley trade yesterday.
recent.author: Nick Kosmider
recent.quoted_text: The #Broncos converted $4.89M of S Talanoa Hufanga's salary into signing bonus, creating $3.9M of 2026 cap space. Updated Cap Hits (dead) 2026: $9.5M ($17M) 2027: $7.6M ($8.4M) 2028: $14.8M (void)
